name: player_apply_alt_weapon_switch
description: Player::ApplyAltWeaponSwitch stores the selected alt controller, updates bank/side state, starts the alt transition state, stops held alt-fire trail runtime when needed, and refreshes the cached alt selection code.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player weapon/source-cluster pass; this target records functional behavior for the alt weapon switch contract.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x439540 validates activeAltGunController assignment, activeAltBankIndex and selectedSide updates, altHardpointSelectState/timer resets, previous-controller transition state 4 with optional StartMasterTypeLoopSfxHandle(0, 1.0f), first-selection transition state 16, held-fire clearing with OptCatalog::DeactivateTrailRuntimeState(previousController->trailRuntimeState), and cachedAltSelectionCode = side + bank * 100.

The native smoke verifies the first-selection path, the previous-controller transition path with local-player SFX, held-fire trail deactivation, bank selected-side update, transition controller/state/timer fields, cached alt selection code, and mode-loop SFX handle ownership.
